title: Cornflower Mauve Boy - 2x Plug Plants - Pollinator friendly Lavender Flowers
description:
Cornflower ‘Mauve Boy’ (Centaurea cyanus) – 2 Plug Plants – Bee-Friendly Cottage Garden Annual
 

 Cornflower ‘Mauve Boy’ is a soft lavender-mauve variety of the much-loved cottage garden classic. A favourite with bees and other pollinators, this easy-to-grow annual produces delicate yet robust blooms that add colour and movement to borders, meadows, and informal planting schemes.


 The flowers make excellent cut stems, lasting well in a vase and mixing beautifully with other garden flowers.


  Key Details:
 

   Variety:
  
  Cornflower ‘Mauve Boy’
 

   Quantity:
  
  2 Plug Plants
 

   Type:
  
  Annual
 

   Genus:
  
   Centaurea cyanus
  

   Flower Colour:
  
  Soft Lavender / Mauve
 

   Height & Spread:
  
  Approx. 60–90 cm tall × 30 cm wide
 

   Flowering Period:
  
  June – September
 

  Growing Instructions
 

   Growing Conditions:
  
    Prefers poor, well-drained soil
   

    Best in full sun
   

    Support with netting if exposed to wind
   


   Plant Out:
  
  July – October
 

   Care Tip:
  
  Regular cutting and deadheading encourage continuous flowering.
 

  Why Choose ‘Mauve Boy’?
 

 A reliable, self-seeding cornflower that brings lasting colour and charm to any garden. Ideal for pollinator-friendly spaces, wildflower meadows, or traditional cottage-style borders.
